title.narrative: Youth Co: Lab Mongolia: Skills, Participation, and Social Entrepreneurship for Mongolia's Youth

description.narrative: Mongolias young and dynamic population represents a major asset for advancing inclusive growth, economic diversification, and sustainable development. Harnessing this demographic potential will be critical to achieving the Sustainable Developmnent Goals and strengthening long-term resilience.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
